# ledger_commitments (Data Source)

Lists commitment definitions, optionally filtered, in identifier order. Every page is read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every domain commitment in euro. Totals of different currencies are never combined.
data "ledger_commitments" "eur_domains" {
  kind     = "domain"
  currency = "EUR"
}

output "domain_names" {
  value = [for c in data.ledger_commitments.eur_domains.items : c.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `currency` (String) Only commitments in this currency.
- `kind` (String) Only commitments of this kind.
- `priority` (String) Only commitments with this priority.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching commitments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount due at each occurrence, an exact decimal string with its original scale.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `currency` (String) The ISO 4217 currency code of amount and match_tolerance.
- `end_date` (String) The last day it applies (inclusive), or null when open-ended.
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier (a ULID).
- `kind` (String) What the commitment pays for: service, server, domain, subscription or debt_repayment.
- `leeway` (Attributes) What the person recorded about the creditor's grace period, or null when nothing is recorded (which differs from kind unknown or none). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--leeway))
- `match_tolerance` (String) The tolerance for automatic payment confirmation (an exact decimal string in currency), or null for none.
- `name` (String) The name.
- `notes` (String) Free-text notes, or null.
- `priority` (String) essential, important or flexible, or null when not prioritised.
- `schedule` (Attributes) When it falls due. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--schedule))
- `start_date` (String) The first day the commitment applies, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version.

<a id="nestedatt--items--leeway"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.leeway`

Read-Only:

- `conditions` (String) What the grace depends on, or null.
- `consequences` (String) Known consequences of paying late, or null.
- `days` (Number) Days of grace for kind period, otherwise null.
- `kind` (String) unknown, none, period or deadline.
- `source` (String) Where the information comes from, or null.
- `until` (String) The deadline for kind deadline, otherwise null.


<a id="nestedatt--items--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.schedule`

Read-Only:

- `day` (Number) The day of the month.
- `frequency` (String) monthly or annual.
- `interval` (Number) Monthly only: months between due dates; null for annual.
- `month` (Number) Annual only: the month; null for monthly.
